title: DINO Eats Geometry: Self-Supervised Sign Representations that Absorb Articulated Hand Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2609.06296v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Handshape and orientation are geometric components of sign language, yet many sign encoders learn from appearance alone. We introduce SignDEG (DINO Eats Geometry), a temporal sign encoder that uses articulated hand geometry as a pre-training target and requires only video at inference. Frozen DINOv3 features of tracked hands and faces feed per-stream temporal Transformers. Geometric latent prediction (GLP) supervises an intermediate block with WiLoR latents, MANO articulation, and 3D joints, including at masked frames. Geometric relation transfer (GRT) matches cross-video frame-similarity distributions at the final block. Both objectives are learned jointly with temporal self-distillation; WiLoR and the geometry heads are then discarded. Under the SHuBERT public-data evaluation protocol, SignDEG reaches 17.9/24.5 BLEU-4 on How2Sign/OpenASL, compared with 16.2/23.2 for SHuBERT. Rank-1 adaptation improves ASL Citizen and Sem-Lex

translated_title: DINO吞噬几何：吸收手部关节几何信息的自监督手语表示
translated_abstract: 手形和手向是手语的几何组成部分，然而许多手语编码器仅从外观进行学习。我们提出SignDEG（DINO Eats Geometry），这是一种时间性手语编码器，它将关节化的手部几何作为预训练目标，且在推理时仅需要视频输入。跟踪得到的手部和面部的冻结DINOv3特征被输入到各模态流的时间Transformer中。几何潜在预测（GLP）在中间层利用WiLoR潜在表示、MANO关节建模和3D关节点进行监督，包括在被掩码的帧上。几何关系迁移（GRT）则在最终层匹配跨视频的帧相似度分布。这两个目标与时间自蒸馏联合学习；训练完成后，WiLoR和几何预测头将被丢弃。在SHuBERT公开数据评估协议下，SignDEG在How2Sign/OpenASL上达到17.9/24.5的BLEU-4分数，相比之下SHuBERT为16.2/23.2。Rank-1自适应提升了在ASL Citizen和Sem-Lex数据集上的表现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SignDEG提出了一种自监督手语编码器，通过在预训练中引入几何潜在预测（GLP）和几何关系迁移（GRT）目标来吸收手部关节几何信息，推理时仅需视频输入，在How2Sign/OpenASL上的BLEU-4分数超过了SHuBERT基线。
en_tdlr: SignDEG is a self-supervised sign encoder that absorbs articulated hand geometry through geometric latent prediction and geometric relation transfer pre-training objectives, requiring only video at inference and outperforming SHuBERT with 17.9/24.5 BLEU-4 on How2Sign/OpenASL.
